<p class="gallery-intro">This page reads films from <code>data/films/letterboxd/ratings.csv</code>. When a film title appears in the title of a post under <code>posts/</code>, the card links to that review automatically.</p>

```{python}
from IPython.display import HTML, display
from src.site_components.media_gallery import render_letterboxd

display(
    HTML(
        render_letterboxd(
            ratings_path="data/films/letterboxd/ratings.csv",
            posts_dir="posts",
            poster_dir="assets/images/letterboxd/posters",
            request_delay=0.5,
        )
    )
)
```
